reviews.text:
If you have a problem, it will only be your problem. They will not help you.. Very disappointing customer service experience. Whenever an issue arises, it feels nearly impossible to get meaningful assistance. Responses are slow, generic, and often fail to address the actual problem being reported. Rather than investigating customer concerns and working toward a resolution, support appears more focused on closing cases without accountability.

A service is only as good as the support behind it, and unfortunately this app falls short in that regard. When customers encounter problems, they should be able to expect fair treatment, clear communication, and a genuine effort to resolve the issue. My experience has been the opposite.

Unless customer support improves significantly, I would have difficulty recommending this app to others.

reviews.text: No food, wasted money. I ordered food few days ahead for fathers’ day, asking it to be delivered in the afternoon. The restaurant owner said the food was ready ahead of time. I tried cancelling the order, but the customer service refused, insisting we get the food that’s already been sitting out for two hours. We then found tons of Reddit and XHS reviews on how this company just scams people and don’t deliver the food. I’ll no longer be using it.

reviews.text:
No Real Customer Support Case Closed Without Resolution. I rarely leave negative reviews, but this experience deserves one.

I mistakenly selected the wrong branch of a chain store due to the app’s search result layout. I immediately contacted customer service. A phone representative called me and initially offered an $8 coupon. I expressed that I would prefer a partial refund instead, and I was told they would escalate the request and call me back.

They did call again, but I missed the call. Instead of attempting further contact, they unilaterally closed my case and rejected the refund.

After that, I was told to use online chat support. The chat agents refused to reconnect me with phone support and insisted on offering only a $10 coupon. When I asked to speak with a phone representative again, they declined and did not escalate the request.

There is no accessible customer service phone number on the website or app. The generic U.S. phone number provided by chat leads only to automated messages with no option to reach a live agent before the call disconnects.

To make matters worse, after I raised these concerns, the chat agents stopped responding altogether. At this point, even receiving the coupon seems uncertain.

This is not about the refund amount anymore. It’s about accountability and access to real customer support. Closing a case simply because a call was missed without providing any proper follow-up channel is unacceptable.

A platform handling payments should have transparent and reachable customer service. Unfortunately, this one does not.
